scope: F2 fold-0 screen. Genuine EBM (ExplainableBoostingClassifier from interpret 0.7.8, interpretml lineage) with REAL pairwise interactions - distinct from the failed stump-based approaches.

protocol.model: ExplainableBoostingClassifier(max_bins=256, interactions=16, max_interaction_bins=16, learning_rate=0.01, max_leaves=11, min_samples_leaf=6, outer_bags=4, inner_bags=0, random_state=1) on the 21 raw covariates (categoricals as integer codes, EBM treats them as categorical via dtype hint when available; else numeric).
protocol.training: outer-FIT (folds 1-4) only; EBM's own internal bagging provides the variance control; no fold-0 row seen during fit.
protocol.evaluation: fold-0 AUC of EBM probability; equal-logit blend with route reference; port_delta and Spearman vs route reference.
protocol.cost_bound: single CPU run; abort if projected > 90 min and record RESOURCE notes with partial-fold evidence.
